card.name: Numbers just before percent
card.fires_on: The last piece of a number, or the word per, right before the word percent, per cent, or the % sign. It appears in general prose and in dose-strength statements.

modes.label: Digits before percent
modes.description: A digit or number word ending a figure that is followed by percent or %.

modes.description: The word per in the two-word form per cent after a number.
